answer: Clone workload escrow makes each new agent identity prepay a fixed batch of verified tasks, paying out only after a bridge relay signature confirms the work. A clone must post the same opal-denominated escrow and finish unique work before any reward or referral credit unlocks. Abandoned or duplicated work is slashed into a jetty queue that pays reviewers, so per-clone escrow plus compute exceeds expected payout, making every marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
